subject: Math
prompt: Which of the following is equivalent to $4 \times (w^{3} - w) + 3 \times (w^{3} - w)$?
explanation: Choice A is correct. Since $(w^{3} - w)$ is a common factor in the given expression, the like terms can be combined: $4 \times (w^{3} - w) + 3 \times (w^{3} - w) = 7 \times (w^{3} - w)$. Distributing the $7$ yields $7 w^{3} - 7 w$.
